nodes.description: Immutable ERC20 token contract held by the timelock (_token).
Immutable beneficiary address that receives the released tokens (_beneficiary).
Immutable timestamp after which tokens can be released (_releaseTime).
TokenTimelock constructor: validates releaseTime_ against block.timestamp and stores token, beneficiary and release time.
View getter returning the held ERC20 token (_token).
View getter returning the beneficiary address (_beneficiary).
View getter returning the release timestamp (_releaseTime).
Public release(): checks block.timestamp >= releaseTime() then transfers the full token balance to the beneficiary.
View helper returning the token balance currently locked in the contract.
SafeERC20.safeTransfer: encodes transfer and performs an optional-return call to the token.
SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom: encodes transferFrom and delegates to the optional-return call helper.
SafeERC20.safeApprove: guards against non-zero to non-zero allowance then performs the approve call.
SafeERC20.safeIncreaseAllowance: computes new allowance and calls approve.
SafeERC20.safeDecreaseAllowance: validates and decrements allowance inside an unchecked block, then calls approve.
SafeERC20._callOptionalReturn: low-level call into the token contract and optional decoding of the boolean return value.
Address.isContract: inline-assembly extcodesize check used to validate call targets.
Address.sendValue: balance check followed by a value-bearing low-level call to a payable recipient.
Address.functionCall(address,bytes): convenience wrapper adding a default revert message.
Address.functionCall(address,bytes,string): wrapper forwarding to functionCallWithValue with value 0.
Address.functionCallWithValue: balance and isContract checks then a value-bearing low-level call and result verification.
Address.functionStaticCall: isContract check followed by a low-level staticcall and result verification.
Address.functionDelegateCall: isContract check followed by a low-level delegatecall and result verification.
Address.verifyCallResult: bubbles up revert data via assembly revert when the low-level call failed.
block.timestamp, used both to validate the constructor release time and to gate release().
recipient.call{value: amount}("") inside Address.sendValue - external value transfer to an arbitrary address.
target.call{value: value}(data) inside Address.functionCallWithValue - arbitrary external call with value.
target.staticcall(data) inside Address.functionStaticCall - arbitrary read-only external call.
target.delegatecall(data) inside Address.functionDelegateCall - arbitrary delegate call executing foreign code in this context.
Low-level external call into the ERC20 token performed by SafeERC20._callOptionalReturn via Address.functionCall.
Constructor parameter token_ assigned to the _token state variable.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ assigned to the _beneficiary state variable.
Constructor parameter releaseTime_ compared with block.timestamp and stored in _releaseTime.
Address.isContract parameter account, whose code size is inspected.
Address.sendValue parameter recipient, the payable destination of the value call.
Address.sendValue parameter amount, the wei value forwarded in the low-level call.
Address call-wrapper parameter target, the arbitrary contract address being called.
Address call-wrapper parameter data, the raw calldata forwarded to the target.
Address call-wrapper parameter errorMessage, the fallback revert reason.
SafeERC20 parameter token, the ERC20 contract target of the wrapped call.
SafeERC20 parameter to, the recipient encoded into the token calldata.
SafeERC20 parameter value, the token amount encoded into the transfer/approve calldata.
Address.functionCallWithValue parameter value, the wei transferred with the external call.
SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom parameter from, the allowance owner encoded into the calldata.
Local size in Address.isContract holding extcodesize(account).
Local amount in release() holding token().balanceOf(address(this)).
Local amount in getLockedAmount() holding the contract token balance.
Local newAllowance in safeIncreaseAllowance computed as allowance + value.
Local oldAllowance in safeDecreaseAllowance read before decrementing.
Local newAllowance in safeDecreaseAllowance computed as oldAllowance - value.
Local returndata in _callOptionalReturn holding the token call's raw return bytes.
Local success flag captured from the low-level calls in sendValue/functionCallWithValue/staticCall/delegateCall.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter token_ is stored into the immutable _token state variable.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is stored into the immutable _beneficiary state variable.
Constructor parameter releaseTime_ is stored into the immutable _releaseTime state variable.
Constructor require(releaseTime_ > block.timestamp) makes deployment dependent on the miner-controlled timestamp.
release() is gated by block.timestamp >= releaseTime(), a timestamp-dependent authorization check.
token() returns the _token state variable.
beneficiary() returns the _beneficiary state variable.
releaseTime() returns the _releaseTime state variable.
release() consumes the value returned by releaseTime() in its require check.
token() result feeds the balanceOf query stored in the local amount of release().
The full locked balance is passed as the amount of the external token transfer.
beneficiary() supplies the destination address of the external token transfer.
release() invokes SafeERC20.safeTransfer to move the tokens.
safeTransfer delegates the encoded call to _callOptionalReturn.
safeTransferFrom delegates the encoded call to _callOptionalReturn.
safeApprove delegates the encoded call to _callOptionalReturn.
safeIncreaseAllowance delegates the encoded approve call to _callOptionalReturn.
safeDecreaseAllowance delegates the encoded approve call to _callOptionalReturn.
_callOptionalReturn performs an external low-level call into the token contract, handing control to untrusted token code while release state is settled.
The token parameter is the target address of the low-level external call.
The to parameter is encoded into the calldata of the low-level external call.
The value parameter is encoded into the calldata of the low-level external call.
The from parameter is encoded into the calldata of the safeTransferFrom low-level call.
The recipient parameter is the destination of the value-bearing low-level call.
The amount parameter is the wei value forwarded in the low-level call.
sendValue executes the external value transfer, giving control to the recipient before finishing.
The account parameter is the subject of the extcodesize inspection stored in size.
The size local determines the boolean returned by isContract.
The target parameter is the callee of the value-bearing external call.
The data parameter is the calldata forwarded in the external call.
The value parameter is the wei amount forwarded with the external call.
functionCallWithValue performs the external call with value, transferring control to an arbitrary target.
The target parameter is the callee of the staticcall.
The data parameter is the calldata forwarded in the staticcall.
functionStaticCall performs the low-level read-only external call.
The target parameter is the callee of the delegatecall.
The data parameter is the calldata forwarded in the delegatecall.
functionDelegateCall performs the low-level delegatecall into untrusted code.
functionCallWithValue funnels the low-level call result into verifyCallResult.
functionStaticCall funnels the staticcall result into verifyCallResult.
functionDelegateCall funnels the delegatecall result into verifyCallResult.
functionCall(address,bytes) forwards to the three-argument overload with a default error message.
functionCall(address,bytes,string) forwards to functionCallWithValue with zero value.
functionCallWithValue relies on isContract to reject calls to addresses without code.
functionStaticCall relies on isContract to validate the staticcall target.
functionDelegateCall relies on isContract to validate the delegatecall target.
getLockedAmount queries token() to read the contract balance.
token() result feeds the balanceOf query stored in the local amount of getLockedAmount().
The local amount is returned by getLockedAmount().
The value parameter is added to the current allowance to produce newAllowance in safeIncreaseAllowance.
oldAllowance is reduced by value to produce newAllowance inside the unchecked block of safeDecreaseAllowance.
The raw returndata captured by _callOptionalReturn is conditionally decoded to a boolean.
The success flag determines whether verifyCallResult bubbles the revert or returns the returndata.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor input token_ only exists to initialize the _token state variable.
Constructor input beneficiary_ only exists to initialize the _beneficiary state variable.
Constructor input releaseTime_ is validated and stored by the constructor.
account is the sole argument of the extcodesize helper and has no independent meaning.
recipient is only used as the destination of the external value transfer.
sendValue's amount is only used as the wei value of the external call.
target is the callee address supplied to the external call wrappers.
data is the raw calldata forwarded to the external call wrappers.
errorMessage is only consumed as the fallback revert reason during call result verification.
The SafeERC20 token parameter is the target address of the low-level token call.
The to parameter is only encoded into the low-level token call calldata.
The amount parameter is only encoded into the low-level token call calldata.
The value parameter is only used as the wei forwarded with the external call.
from is only encoded into the transferFrom calldata built by safeTransferFrom.
size is a transient local holding extcodesize, immediately returned by isContract.
The local amount is a temporary balance read inside release() with no cross-function lifetime.
The local amount is immediately returned by getLockedAmount().
newAllowance is a transient computation fed straight into the approve call.
oldAllowance is read once and consumed by the decrement computation.
newAllowance is a transient computation fed straight into the approve call.
returndata is a temporary buffer used only to decode the optional boolean result.
success is a transient low-level call flag immediately consumed by verifyCallResult.
